title: Eton Mess
description: A traditional dish from United Kingdom, centered on chicken egg, heavy cream, strawberry. A measured home-kitchen version organized by cooking step.

steps.instruction: Separate the egg whites and whisk them with sugar to stiff glossy peaks for the meringue.
Bake small meringue nests at 110°C until dry and crisp, around 65 minutes, then cool completely.
Whisk or whip the listed ingredients to a smooth, light consistency, then keep cool until needed.
Wash and prepare the listed produce; dice or chop evenly for a consistent texture.
Break the cooled meringues into pieces and fold lightly with whipped cream and strawberries just before serving.
Chill briefly if appropriate, garnish with the listed ingredients and serve at the intended temperature.
